host_contract.entry: lock(nativeSession), setForeground, setPictureInPicture, and actual player screen bounds via setPlayerViewport
host_contract.ready: onReady(session, windowEpoch) only after Dialog focus and valid exact-position affordance; each genuine renewed readiness has a monotonic epoch
host_contract.hold: One continuous pointer for 2000 uptime milliseconds requests unlock exactly once; interruption invalidates the request generation
host_contract.unlock: onUnlockRequested(session, windowEpoch, request) remains locked. Root Bridge validates canConfirmUnlocked(tuple), attempts atomic nativeCommit(session,grant), then confirmUnlocked(tuple) in the same UI turn. Native refusal keeps lock and invokes rejectUnlock for retry.
host_contract.retirement: Only playbackStopped(exactSession) or ownerDestroyed retires without successful unlock; unknown player state is not a stop
host_contract.background_and_pip: Dialog is hidden while session remains locked; native enforcement and root lifecycle integration must protect reentry until onReady
host_contract.geometry: Entire existing top-left hit region is used; no minimum 48dp promise because exact bounds can be smaller on cover/landscape
host_contract.revocation: onNotReady(session, windowEpoch, cancelledRequest) before state clear/hide/reflow, with the old request token; reentrant confirmation is blocked while revocation is delivered
host_contract.reentrancy: Readiness announcement is published before callback and guarded against nested announcements; callbacks are revalidated afterward. Revocation clears the published lease before callback and blocks confirm. These Android callback paths were compiled and source-reviewed, not Android-executed.
host_contract.window_unavailable: Host.onWindowUnavailable(session) after candidate cleanup for BadToken/IllegalState during show, only while exact session remains owned. Bridge differentiates never-ready entry failure from established-session window loss.
